checks.name: Nonnegative stock
checks.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM api.__OP___inventory WHERE stock<0) AS passed

checks.name: No orphan order items
checks.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM api.__OP___items i WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM api.__OP___orders o WHERE o.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND o.id=i.order_id)) AS passed

checks.name: Order totals match items
checks.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM api.__OP___orders o WHERE o.total_cents IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT COALESCE(sum(i.quantity::bigint*i.unit_price_cents),0) FROM api.__OP___items i WHERE i.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND i.order_id=o.id)) AS passed
